about: THE source of Amir's Motion Menu (since the tidy of 2026-10-01). One record per card: groups, items (every kind), and in `retired` what left and why. Edit this, then run tools/menu_patch.py, publish (kit/MENU.md). `no` is the permanent menu number: a removed number is never used again, the next new one is 226. A /cut ingredient has `cut` (its kit block) and `how` (the call). Its sample is `sample` (showreel number, t0, t1, poster, in seconds). A sound has `file`, `dur`, `vol`, `track` and kit.py puts it in the SFX table, so every sound in the menu can be cued.

groups.name: Wipes and cuts
groups.blurb: How one shot or card hands over to the next. Use two or three kinds in a reel.

groups.name: Camera moves
groups.blurb: Moves on your own footage. The first three come from the cut plan, not from a block.

groups.name: Words arrive
groups.blurb: How a word lands. Pick one way and keep it for the whole reel.

groups.name: Words and stamps
groups.blurb: One word or one short phrase you stress. Never a caption: you add those.

groups.name: Numbers and charts
groups.blurb: A number, a range or a chart. Only numbers you give.

groups.name: Lists and steps
groups.blurb: Things you count off, in order.

groups.name: Against each other
groups.blurb: Two things side by side, or a wrong word and its fix.

groups.name: Curves and force
groups.blurb: How something changes over time. A drawn idea, never your data.

groups.name: Body and movement
groups.blurb: A place in the body, a chain of joints, the heart.

groups.name: Court
groups.blurb: Distances, steps and turns on a court.

groups.name: Behind you
groups.blurb: Between the wall and you. Needs you cut out of the picture.

groups.name: Chapters, questions and the ask
groups.blurb: The hinges of a reel: a part label, a question, the call to action.

groups.name: Yours
groups.blurb: Ideas you added here. I build each one and give it a number.

groups.name: Look
groups.blurb: Colours and type. The same for every reel.

groups.name: Feel
groups.blurb: Easing: the name to call a movement by, and the code behind it.

groups.name: House rules
groups.blurb: How picture and sound stay together.

groups.name: Sweeps
groups.blurb: Carry a wipe, a slide or a cut.

groups.name: Builds
groups.blurb: Tension before a hit.

groups.name: Hits
groups.blurb: Something lands.

groups.name: Ticks and blips
groups.blurb: Small confirmations: a tick, a pop, a list row.

groups.name: Bells
groups.blurb: A win, a result, something done.

groups.name: Sport and body
groups.blurb: The court, the gym and the heart.

groups.name: Music
groups.blurb: A bed under a reel, if you want one. /cut adds none: you add music in Instagram.

items.name: Clay Wipe
items.label: A clay line sweeps right to left and the next card follows it.
items.how: wipeVariant:"clay" on any card, or K.wipeIn(layer, t, d, "clay")
items.when: Going from a full card to the next shot, in the brand look. The line can carry a word or a number.

items.name: Iris
items.label: A circle opens like an eye into the next card.
items.when: Your default for a question card or a hinge. A circle opens into the next card.

items.name: Push
items.label: The next card slides over the picture.
items.when: A card that slides over the picture and takes over. Clean and quiet. Your other favourite.

items.name: Slice
items.label: Six bars step in from the right and the next card follows.
items.when: A sharper hand-over for a list or a number card.

items.name: Zoom Through
items.label: A circle opens while the next card rushes in.
items.when: Going into a big statement: a number, a verdict, the answer.

items.name: Whip Cut
items.label: The picture blurs and slides away to hide a jump cut.
items.how: K.whip(t, {out, in, style:"whip"}) (out and in are segment numbers)
items.when: A jump cut inside one thought that should feel on purpose.

items.name: Zoom Cut
items.label: A quick push through the picture hides a jump cut.
items.when: The same job with more energy: a quick push through the picture.

items.name: Flash
items.label: A hard cut on a white flash.
items.when: The one moment that matters, like the reveal or the answer. Once per reel at most.

items.name: Push In
items.label: A slow push toward the speaker, like walking in. Use it for emphasis.
items.when: A line you want to land: the claim, the answer, the number you are about to say.
items.how: Cut plan: {zoom:1.0, drift:0.10} is a slow push over the segment, {zoom:1.15, punch:true} is a quick settle on the cut.

items.name: Pull Out
items.label: Pull back out to the wide shot after a close-up.
items.when: After a close-up, when the next idea starts. Or to end on the wide shot.
items.how: Cut plan: {zoom:1.2, drift:-0.12} is a slow pull back, or cut to a segment with zoom:1.0.

items.name: There and Back
items.label: Push in for the point, hold, then return to exactly the wide shot you started on.
items.when: One strong point inside a calm stretch. Push in, hold, return to the exact wide shot.
items.how: Cut plan: three segments, wide zoom:1.0, tight zoom:1.15 with punch:true, wide zoom:1.0. Cut at word boundaries.

items.name: Drift
items.label: Slide to a new framing while pushing in a little. A way to make room for a graphic.
items.when: A graphic needs the side or the top of the frame.
items.how: Not built. K.backdrop(seg, {lower:true}) already sinks you to make headroom. A sideways slide needs a per-segment origin in plan_to_clips.py.

items.name: Word Entrance
items.label: How a word lands: it rises from behind a line, pops with a springy overshoot, drops and bounces once, or slams in from the camera.
items.when: Every time a word appears. Pick ONE way and keep it for the whole reel.

items.name: Heavy Word
items.label: A word grows from thin to black as it slides in.
items.when: The one word you lean on, like heavy, strong or power.
items.how: Not built. Vazirmatn has a weight axis, so the weight can grow with font-variation-settings (100 to 900).

items.name: Stamp
items.label: One clay stamp per spoken word. It pops, slides or drops in.
items.when: A short phrase you stress, up to about four words: a hook, a name, a contrast. Never a caption.

items.name: Tag
items.label: A small stamp beside you with a ring burst. Often over a huge faint number.
items.how: K.tag(word, {at, x, y, out}) with K.ghost for the faint number
items.when: One word you say with weight. It sits beside you, often over a faint number.

items.name: Ghost Numeral
items.label: A huge faint number sitting behind the scene.
items.when: A number or a 'one thing' idea, where the wall beside your head is free. You called this family premium.

items.name: Number Slam
items.label: A number rolls like an odometer and lands with a slam. Its unit drops in below.
items.how: K.number("12", {at, landAt, unit, unitAt, look:"clay", shake})
items.when: A number you say with weight: a time, a distance, a count, a percent. It must be your number.

items.name: Number Behind
items.label: A number rolls behind your head like an odometer and lands with a ring. A small unit stamps on your chest.
takes: the small unit on your chest
items.how: K.backdrop(seg, {lower:true}) + K.slamBehind(seg, "12", {at, landAt, out}) + K.tag(unit). Needs the cut-out.
items.when: The number is the hinge of the reel and there is headroom. Your best one.

items.name: Range
items.label: A range counts up, like 2 to 13 m. The two ends land one after the other.
items.when: A range you say: 8 to 12 reps, RPE 7 to 8, 2 to 13 metres.
items.how: Not built. It would be K.number with two numbers landing one after the other.

items.name: Stat Chart
items.label: A number as a picture: a ring that counts up to a percent, bars that grow with the last one lit, or a line that draws itself.
items.when: A share, a comparison across a few values, or a change over weeks. Only numbers you give.
items.how: Not built. Three forms: a ring that counts to a percent, bars with the last one lit, a line with one point called out.

items.name: Dial
items.label: A rev counter. The needle climbs in steps and the word in the middle changes: ENGINE, POWER, SPEED.
items.when: Effort, intensity or RPE. A needle climbs in steps and the word in the middle changes. One metaphor per video at most.

items.name: Drum
items.label: A list turns on a drum, one line at a time, then opens flat. On your video your face stays. As a card it takes the whole screen.
items.used: your video or a full card
items.when: 3 to 5 short items, one phrase each, counted off one at a time. On your video unless your hands gesture over your chest.

items.name: Steps
items.label: Steps joined by arrows, built as you say each one. On your video it picks a row, a grid or a stack, whichever fits. As a card it is a staircase of plates.
takes: on your video or a card
items.used: your video or a full card
items.how: K.diagram(steps, {mode:"video"|"card", at, nodeAt, out}). The layout picks itself.
items.said: You prefer this to the full card
items.when: A sequence or a cause chain of 2 to 4 steps. On your video when the words fit, a card when they do not.

items.name: Loop
items.label: Four steps in a circle: the last arrow runs back to the first and everything lights. On your video or as a card.
items.used: your video or a full card
items.how: K.diagram(steps, {loop:true, mode:"video"|"card", at, nodeAt, loopAt, out})
items.when: A cycle of exactly four: train, rest, adapt, repeat.

items.name: Checklist
items.label: Rules arrive as you name them, then each one gets ticked.
items.when: You set 2 to 4 rules, then prove each one later. The ticks land when you come back to them.

items.name: Chips
items.label: Options pop in one by one as you say them.
items.when: You list 3 or 4 short options.

items.name: Versus
items.label: A split screen: two sides slide in and meet on a slanted seam. Add a verdict and the seam moves.
items.how: K.versus(a, b, {at, vs, win:"a"|"b"}). vs can be a not-equal sign.
items.when: A myth against a fact, a wrong way against a right way, A or B, or two things that are not equal.

items.name: Cross Out
items.label: A wrong word is struck out with a clay line, and the right one is set in green.
items.when: One word you correct: not this, that.
items.how: Not built. A clay line strikes the wrong word and the right one lands in green.

items.name: Curve and Slope
items.label: A force-time graph: the axes draw, a curve draws with a glowing head, and its slope is marked with its rise and run.
takes: the two words on the axes
items.how: K.curve({at, out, yLabel, xLabel, curves:[{at, tone, x0, k}], slope:{at, label}})
items.when: Force over time, the rate of force development, fatigue, adaptation: anything with a curve. I suggest it without being asked.

items.name: Time Saved
items.label: Two curves reach the same peak. The faster one gets there sooner and the time saved lights up on the axis.
takes: the label for the time saved
items.how: K.curve({at, out, curves:[slow, fast], gap:{at, level, label}})
items.when: Two methods or two athletes reach the same peak, one sooner.

items.name: Muscle Map
items.label: The app's own body. Muscles light up as you say them, with a label, and the body turns round to show the back.
items.how: K.bodymap(steps, {at, out}). A step is {m, label, at, view}.
items.said: Amazing. Use it whenever you talk about a place in the body
items.when: You name muscles. Each one lights as you say it and the body turns round for the back. Use it for any place in the body.

items.name: Joint Chain
items.label: Hip, knee and ankle light in order and a pulse runs down the leg.
items.when: Hips, knees and ankles in order, like triple extension.

items.name: Heartbeat
items.label: A dot pulses with a ring, like a pulse. Or a heartbeat line scrolls under a number.
items.when: Heart rate, conditioning, recovery.

items.name: Court Steps
items.label: A court in 3D. A ball is struck, a runner takes a few steps to it and leaves ghosts, and numbers stand up.
items.how: K.courtSteps3d({at, hit, steps, line1, line2, out})
items.when: A few seconds, a few steps: speed, reaction, how far a player covers.

items.name: Court Distance
items.label: A court in 3D. A measuring line, a sprint along it and numbers rising at each mark.
items.how: K.courtMeasure3d({at, label, from, to, value, unit, out})
items.when: A distance you name: 5 m, 10 m, a sprint.

items.name: Pivot
items.label: The angle of a change of direction: the way in, the way out, and the turn measured.
items.when: A change of direction: the way in, the way out and the angle.

items.name: Word Behind
items.label: One word appears behind your head, with the room dimmed. Needs you cut out.
items.how: K.behind(seg, [{text}], {at, out, dim}). Needs the cut-out.
items.when: The reveal: the one word the reel turns on. Once per reel unless it is the spine.

items.name: Word Stack
items.label: Lines of type rise one by one behind you.
items.how: K.stack(seg, lines, {at, out, top, size}). Needs the cut-out.
items.when: There is headroom (after a studio swap) or a short echo above your head.

items.name: Hollow Word
items.label: A giant hollow word draws on behind you, then can fill solid.
items.how: K.outline(seg, word, {at, fillAt, out, size}). Needs the cut-out.
items.when: The one word as texture or as a reveal. It draws on, then fills solid on a beat.

items.name: Drifting Rows
items.label: Rows of one word slide slowly behind you at different speeds.
takes: the speed and direction of each row
items.how: K.drift(seg, word, {at, out, rows}). Needs the cut-out.
items.when: A beat where you stay still and the room needs life. It is texture, not text to read.

items.name: Studio Swap
items.label: The room turns into a studio colour and only you stay. You sink a little to make room for type.
items.how: K.backdrop(seg, {at, out, tone, variant, lower:true}). Needs the cut-out.
items.when: The hinge of the reel: the room becomes a colour and you sink to make room for type.

items.name: Soft Room
items.label: The room goes soft and dark while you stay sharp.
items.how: K.focus(seg, {at, out, blur, dim}). Needs the cut-out.
items.when: A quiet, serious line. The room goes soft and dark, you stay sharp. No verdict yet.

items.name: Chapter
items.label: A clay band across your chest names each part: the number rolls like a counter and the title lands. As a card the whole screen goes clay.
items.used: your video or a full card
items.how: K.chapter(n, title, {variant:"band"|"card", at, landAt, titleAt, total})
items.said: You prefer this to the full card
items.when: The reel is in parts: first, second, third. Two or three chapters at most. The band first, the card for a bigger break.

items.name: Question Card
items.label: A full clay card with one line slammed as a stamp, while your voice carries on.
items.when: A question or a hinge in the argument. A breather for the eye. Not right after a court card.

items.name: Call to Action
items.label: A comment bubble pops with the ask, and a small line under it.
items.when: The ask at the end: comment, follow, link.

items.name: Signal Colours
items.label: Five colours, five jobs. Bone is normal, clay is the key word, green is the fix, grey is detail, a clay line is a mistake.
items.when: Every reel. It is the colour language.
items.how: Bone is normal text, clay is the key word, green is the fix or done, grey is detail, a clay line is a mistake. They are the kit's tokens.

items.name: Farsi Type
items.label: Vazirmatn for every Farsi word: right to left, no capitals, no letter spacing, Persian digits, and each word moves as one piece. Barlow for Latin numbers and @amirardekanian.
items.when: Every word on screen.
items.how: Fonts: assets/fonts/Vazirmatn-Variable.woff2. K.fa(12) gives the Persian digits. Put ‌ where a word needs the half space. Counters get direction:ltr.

items.name: Settle
items.label: Fast arrival, long soft landing.
items.when: Almost every entrance. The default.

items.name: Overshoot
items.label: Goes past the mark, then settles back.
items.when: Something that should feel alive: a tag, a stamp, a tick.

items.name: Glide
items.label: Slow, fast, slow.
items.when: A move between two places: a card sliding, a wipe.

items.name: Bounce
items.label: Drops and bounces to rest.
items.when: A drop that lands with weight.

items.name: Stagger
items.label: Start each piece a little after the last.
items.when: A row of things that start one after another.

items.name: Sound Lock
items.label: The sound goes on the frame the graphic lands. If it feels late, land the graphic one or two frames early.
items.when: Every time a graphic lands.
items.how: In build.py: sfx=[(E(t), "thump")] where t is the second the graphic lands (its landAt).

items.name: Whoosh
items.label: A soft air sweep.
items.when: Under every wipe and slide. Start it as the move starts.

items.name: Swish
items.label: A fast sweep that travels right to left.
items.when: A whip cut or a quick slide. Faster and brighter than the whoosh.

items.name: Inhale
items.label: A quick reverse swell that pulls into the next scene.
items.when: A zoom or an iris that pulls the viewer into the next scene.

items.name: Glassline
items.label: A glassy tone that climbs while something draws.
items.when: Under a curve, a line or a court drawing itself.

items.name: Riser
items.label: A rising swoosh that builds to a hit.
items.when: About two seconds before a big landing: a number, a verdict, a chapter.

items.name: Snare Roll
items.label: A fast roll that builds tension.
items.when: Under the number odometer. Place it so it ends on the landing.

items.name: Thump
items.label: A soft low knock under a hit.
items.when: Under every stamp, tag and landing. The default hit.

items.name: Boom
items.label: A deep, low explosion.
items.when: The big moment: the number slam, a chapter card, the answer.

items.name: Crash
items.label: A bright cymbal splash.
items.when: A finale: the last word, the verdict.

items.name: Drop
items.label: Silence, then kick, boom and crash together.
items.when: The one hinge of the reel. Once.

items.name: Knock
items.label: The wooden knock when a letter lands.
items.when: A drum item turning, a word dropping in.

items.name: Click
items.label: A tactile switch click.
items.when: A small thing appearing or switching: a chip, a list row.

items.name: Ticks
items.label: Fast tiny ticks, like a ruler printing.
items.when: A drum turning, a measuring line, numbers counting.

items.name: Plink
items.label: Three light plucks for ticking things off.
items.when: A checklist ticking, a fix landing.

items.name: Boop
items.label: A small round blip.
items.when: A small pop: a bubble, a stamp popping, a chip.

items.name: Chime
items.label: A bell chord that rings out.
items.when: A win or a result: the verdict turns green, the loop closes.

items.name: Ping
items.label: A single high bell note.
items.when: A small win: one item done.

items.name: Footsteps
items.label: Four sneaker steps on a hard court, two with a squeak.
items.when: A runner on the court graphic. Four steps, two with a squeak.

items.name: Ball Hit
items.label: A racket hitting a tennis ball, first hard, then soft.
items.when: The strike in the court graphic.

items.name: Ball Bounce
items.label: A ball bouncing three times, each bounce lower and quicker.
items.when: A ball bouncing three times, each one lower.

items.name: Clank
items.label: A weight plate touching a barbell, twice, the second one lighter.
items.when: Gym talk: loading a bar, a plate touching the barbell.

items.name: Thud Drop
items.label: A heavy plate dropped on a rubber floor.
items.when: A heavy plate dropped on a rubber floor: heavy, hard landings.

items.name: Lub-Dub
items.label: Two soft thumps, like a pulse.
items.when: The heartbeat graphic: heart rate, recovery.

items.name: Groove
items.label: A bass line that bounces with the kick.
items.when: A music bed under a reel, if you want one. You marked it Keep.
